_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Foundational multi-administratie (multi-tenant) layer. Declares Administration as a first-class register record (the juridisch-onafhankelijke boekhouding boundary), the AdministrationMembership user-administratie-role join, the IntercompanyJournalEntry mirrored-pair tracker, the ConsolidationMapping chart-of-accounts mapping, and the AdministrationMigration asset/contract/employee transfer audit record. Field names follow the app's existing English camelCase convention (administrationId already on GLTransaction/Account/FixedAsset/BalanceSheet); the Dutch context-brief names map 1:1. Schema membership of the shillinq register is by components.schemas key (objects carry @self.register=shillinq); the existing ConsolidationGroup/ConsolidatedReport schemas are NOT touched. Lifecycle is declared via x-openregister-lifecycle and relations via property-level $ref (ADR-031 declarative, no service classes for storage). Seed objects provide a worked holding-werkmij (Beheer B.V. / Werk B.V.) example plus an accounting-firm multi-client example.

Administration.title: Administration
Administration.description: A legally self-contained bookkeeping entity (juridisch-onafhankelijke boekhouding). The first-class multi-tenant isolation boundary: every financial record carries an administrationId FK to this schema. Each Administration owns its own chart-of-accounts, fiscal-year cycle, presentation currency and VAT regime independently of other administrations. Holding/werkmij structures link via parentAdministrationId / childAdministrationIds.

backupSchedule.title: Backup Schedule

dataRetentionYears.description: Wettelijke bewaartermijn in years (default 7; 10 for onroerende zaken) (REQ-MA-007, AWR art. 52).

actief.label: Actief

gearchiveerd.label: Gearchiveerd

opgeheven.label: Opgeheven
opgeheven.description: Terminated; retained for the wettelijke bewaartermijn, fully read-only.

archive.label: Archiveren

close.label: Opheffen

archiveLiquidated.label: Archiveren na liquidatie

AdministrationMembership.title: Administration Membership
AdministrationMembership.description: Join record granting a Nextcloud user a role in a single Administration. One user may hold many memberships with a different role per administration; access is the administratie-aware RBAC boundary. The userId is the Nextcloud account uid (a contact/person is a Nextcloud entity — no person schema is invented).

userId.description: Nextcloud user uid that this membership grants access for.
userId.title: User ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration this membership grants access to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

role.description: Role the user holds in this administration. Roles map to permission bundles checked server-side.
role.title: Role

ledgerAccessRestriction.description: Optional grootboek account ranges this membership is restricted to (e.g. ["4000-4999"]).
ledgerAccessRestriction.title: Ledger Access Restriction

mayPostJournalEntries.description: Whether the membership may post journaalposten in this administration.
mayPostJournalEntries.title: May Post Journal Entries

mayCloseFiscalYear.description: Whether the membership may perform jaarafsluiting in this administration.
mayCloseFiscalYear.title: May Close Fiscal Year

validFrom.description: Date from which the membership is valid.
validFrom.title: Valid From

validUntil.description: Date the membership expires; null = open-ended.
validUntil.title: Valid Until

grantedBy.description: Nextcloud uid of the operator who granted this membership (audit).
grantedBy.title: Granted By

IntercompanyJournalEntry.title: Intercompany Journal Entry
IntercompanyJournalEntry.description: Tracking record linking the two mirrored GLTransactions of an intercompany transaction across two administrations. The two journal entries themselves live in each administration's own journal (Dutch GAAP: each entity keeps a self-contained journaal); this record holds the link, the reconciliation variance and the consolidation-elimination flag.

intercompanyNumber.description: Unique intercompany identifier linking both sides.
intercompanyNumber.title: Intercompany Number

date.description: Booking date of the intercompany transaction.
date.title: Date

sourceAdministrationId.description: FK to the source (bron) administration where the originating journaalpost is booked.
sourceAdministrationId.title: Source Administration ID

destinationAdministrationId.description: FK to the destination (doel) administration where the mirrored journaalpost is booked.
destinationAdministrationId.title: Destination Administration ID

sourceJournalEntryId.description: FK to the GLTransaction in the source administration.
sourceJournalEntryId.title: Source Journal Entry ID

destinationJournalEntryId.description: FK to the mirrored GLTransaction in the destination administration.
destinationJournalEntryId.title: Destination Journal Entry ID

amount.description: Transaction amount in the transaction currency.
amount.title: Amount

exchangeRate.description: FX rate applied if the currency differs from the destination presentation currency.
exchangeRate.title: Exchange Rate

description.description: Human-readable description of the intercompany transaction.
description.example: Management fee Q2 2026 van Werk B.V. aan Beheer B.V.
description.title: Description

vatTreatment.description: BTW treatment of the intercompany flow.
vatTreatment.title: VAT Treatment

eliminateOnConsolidation.description: Marks the matching P&L lines on both sides for elimination at consolidation time. Consumed by the future bookkeeping-consolidatie spec.
eliminateOnConsolidation.title: Eliminate On Consolidation

eliminationAccount.description: GL account number used for the consolidation elimination adjustment.
eliminationAccount.title: Elimination Account

status.description: Mirroring status. draft = one side drafted; gekoppeld = both sides exist; bevestigd_beide = both confirmed; eliminatie_geboekt = consolidation elimination processed.
status.title: Status

varianceAmount.description: Reconciliation variance (afwijking) between the two sides; non-zero flags the pair for manual review.
varianceAmount.title: Variance Amount

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: One side drafted; the mirror has not yet been created.

gekoppeld.label: Gekoppeld
gekoppeld.description: Both journal entries exist and are linked via intercompanyNumber.

bevestigd_beide.label: Bevestigd beide
bevestigd_beide.description: Both administrations have confirmed their side.

link.label: Koppelen
link.description: The mirrored journal entry is created in the destination administration.

confirmBoth.label: Bevestigen
confirmBoth.description: Both sides confirm; the pair is locked for reconciliation.

reopen.label: Heropenen
reopen.description: An edit on one unconfirmed-mirror side returns the pair to concept; the counterparty must re-confirm.

eliminate.label: Elimineren
eliminate.description: Consolidation elimination is booked for this intercompany pair. REQ-MA-004 / revive-gl-tax-capabilities REQ-GLTAX-002 — guarded: the pair must reconcile (zero varianceAmount between the source and the counter-side entry) before the elimination may be booked. Fail-closed when the counter-side entry cannot be resolved.

ConsolidationMapping.title: Consolidation Mapping
ConsolidationMapping.description: Maps a dochter administration's chart-of-accounts onto the moeder's for consolidation, plus the intercompany elimination account and currency-translation method. Mapping rules are stored as a JSON array (ADR-031 declarative — no separate line-item schema). Consumed by the future bookkeeping-consolidatie spec; no consolidation rendering logic lives here.

rules.description: Account-mapping rules: each maps a source GL account to a destination GL account.

description.description: Human-readable note for this mapping rule.
description.title: Description

rules.title: Rules

intercompanyEliminationAccount.description: GL account used to book intercompany eliminations at consolidation.
intercompanyEliminationAccount.title: Intercompany Elimination Account

validFrom.description: Date from which the mapping is effective.
validFrom.title: Valid From

AdministrationMigration.title: Administration Migration
AdministrationMigration.description: Audit record of an asset / contract / employee transfer between two administrations during internal restructuring. Captures boekwaarde vs marktwaarde, the juridische grondslag, the fiscale behandeling, and the paired GLTransaction references on both sides so the transfer is reversible without breaking the audit trail.

sourceAdministrationId.description: FK to the administration the object leaves.
sourceAdministrationId.title: Source Administration ID

destinationAdministrationId.description: FK to the administration the object enters.
destinationAdministrationId.title: Destination Administration ID

bookValueTransferred.description: Boekwaarde of the transferred object at the migration date.
bookValueTransferred.title: Book Value Transferred

marketValueTransferred.description: Marktwaarde / overdrachtswaarde of the transferred object.
marketValueTransferred.title: Market Value Transferred

resultImpact.description: P&L impact (verschil_naar_resultaat) recognised on the transfer.
resultImpact.title: Result Impact

legalBasis.description: Juridische grondslag (e.g. notariële akte reference) underpinning the transfer.
legalBasis.example: Akte van inbreng dd 2026-08-15 notaris X
legalBasis.title: Legal Basis

documentIds.description: File references for supporting documents (akte, taxatie).
documentIds.title: Document Ids

sourceJournalEntryId.description: FK to the deactivation/disposal GLTransaction in the source administration.
sourceJournalEntryId.title: Source Journal Entry ID

destinationJournalEntryId.description: FK to the activation GLTransaction in the destination administration.
destinationJournalEntryId.title: Destination Journal Entry ID

status.description: Migration lifecycle. voorbereid = drafted; uitgevoerd = one side posted; geboekt_beide = both posted (atomic); teruggedraaid = reversed.
status.title: Status

voorbereid.label: Voorbereid
voorbereid.description: Both sides drafted but not yet posted; safe to edit or cancel.

uitgevoerd.label: Uitgevoerd
uitgevoerd.description: Transfer in progress; one side posted.

geboekt_beide.label: Geboekt beide
geboekt_beide.description: Both paired journal entries posted; the migration is complete and locked.

teruggedraaid.label: Teruggedraaid
teruggedraaid.description: Both journal entries reversed; both administrations returned to their pre-migration state.

execute.label: Uitvoeren
execute.description: Begin posting the paired journal entries.

complete.label: Afronden
complete.description: Both paired journal entries posted simultaneously (atomic).

reverse.label: Terugdraaien
reverse.description: Reverse both journal entries; restore the pre-migration state.

cancel.label: Annuleren
cancel.description: Cancel a prepared migration before any side is posted.

AdministrationBackupRun.title: Administration Backup Run
AdministrationBackupRun.description: Audit record of one per-administration backup run. Each row carries exactly one administrationId — backups are scoped per administratie so no cross-tenant data leaks into a single backup file. Written by AdministrationBackupSchedulerJob (BackgroundJob, Task 15).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this backup covers.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

schedule.description: Backup-schedule slug that triggered the run.
schedule.title: Schedule

snapshotOnly.description: True when the administration is archived/opgeheven and the backup is a read-only snapshot.
snapshotOnly.title: Snapshot Only

sizeBytes.description: Size of the backup payload in bytes.
sizeBytes.title: Size Bytes

nextBackupAt.description: Computed next scheduled backup instant; null for on-request schedules.
nextBackupAt.title: Next Backup At

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Administration Backup Run is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
